question:
The code name of India - Pakistan kargil war was ________.

A. Operation Blue Star

B. Operation Vijay

C. Operation Viraat

D. Operation Kargil
solution:
Option **1** is correct, i.e. **__Operation Vijay__**.

 
• The code name of **India - Pakistan kargil** war was **Operation Vijay**.
